messages:
jamie_marketing: Heads-up — noticed a weird drop between webinar regs -> MQLs yesterday. Dashboard shows normal reg volume but MQL conversion down ~22% vs baseline. Anyone else seeing this?

tom_analytics: seeing the same on the live dashboard. Quick check: is this across all channels or concentrated?

jamie_marketing: looks heavier on paid LinkedIn and organic blog UTM. Paid lead quality was fine in past events so curious. Sharing viz: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/registrations?view=week

maria_data: pulled a micro-cohort. snippet: ```channel | regs | mqls | conv%
organic | 420 | 98 | 23.3%
linkedin_paid | 310 | 41 | 13.2%
email_nurture | 190 | 62 | 32.6%``` Might be attribution/UTM mapping issues or gating change.

anya_growth: thanks Maria. Did we change the MQL rule or scoring model in the last 48hrs?

leo_csm: nope, scoring rule unchanged. Small tweak to the demo request form copy (A/B) rolled ~3 days ago but doesn't touch required fields.

tom_analytics: two quick hypotheses: 1) tag/UTM normalization failing (multiple linkedin params mapping to unknown channel) 2) sample-rate / ingestion lag on webhook -> MQL pipeline (we had a small spike in queue retries).

raj_growth: @maria_data can you confirm whether UTM variants like `utm_campaign=SummerLaunch` vs `utm_campaign=summer_launch` were being deduped? I remember a recent parser change.

maria_data: checked. parser normalizes campaign and source to lowercase but not medium. We have `paid-social` vs `paid_social` showing as separate in raw. That could split counts; conversion % should still be per-variant though.

opsbot: Deploy: parse-fix v3.4 was rolled 2025-06-03 02:12 UTC. No schema change.

jamie_marketing: ok — if parsing split the channel into two small buckets, that could drop apparent conv% for the main bucket. But the magnitude seems > expected.

tom_analytics: another data point — look at time-to-mql. If webhooks retried, time lag might push MQLs outside the daily window we were querying. For linkedin_paid cohort, median time-to-mql jumped from 6h -> 28h in yesterday's cohort.

maria_data: confirmed. For linkedin_paid (raw id set) median ttf (time-to-final) = 27.3h yesterday vs 5.8h typical. Queue logs show ~1.2k retries during the 00-06 UTC batch.

anya_growth: that would explain dashboard snapshot skew (we're using calendar-day buckets). If MQLs land >24h later they drop out of the same-day conversion numerator.

leo_csm: so two levers: fix normalization noise and widen the dashboard window or annotate with 48h-rolling conversion.

jamie_marketing: agreed. Priority: short-term — adjust dashboard to 48h rolling conv for yesterday's cohort and add note. Medium-term — patch webhook retry thresholds and ensure queued items reingest with original event_ts.

tom_analytics: I'll update the dashboard. Quick diff: change SQL WHERE event_ts >= cohort_start AND event_ts < cohort_end + interval '48 hours'. Should be non-destructive.

maria_data: I'll add a one-off backfill for the affected window and normalize the medium variants to `paid-social` in the canonical table.

raj_growth: can we also add a UTMs sampling sanity check to the daily ETL alert? If a new variant appears >0.5% it should flag.

jamie_marketing: yes please. Also want a short blurb for tomorrow's weekly KPI sync: "Webinar -> MQL dip traced to webhook retrying + UTM fragmentation; dashboard corrected to 48h rolling; backfill pending." Keep it one-liner.

leo_csm: cc @sales — FYI this is not lead quality, it's a plumbing artifact. We'll push that note in the morning.

tom_analytics: pushed dashboard change to staging, running compare. Link: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/registrations?view=48h

opsbot: Job alert: ETL-replay job queued (id 98321).

maria_data: started backfill. ETA ~45m. Will post results.

jamie_marketing: thanks team. If the backfill restores conv% to baseline we close this as "reporting anomaly" at the weekly sync. If not, we escalate to funnel quality investigation. :thumbsup:

maria_data: backfill complete. After 48h window conversion for linkedin_paid = 29.1% (baseline ~30%). Looks like resolved.

anya_growth: great — updated weekly KPI note: "Resolved: temporary reporting drop due to ingestion retries + utm variants; corrected dashboard & backfilled data."

jamie_marketing: perfect. Adding to Monday agenda. Closing thread unless anyone objects.

leo_csm: no objections.

raj_growth: thanks all."
